sources.title: The Paesani Research Group
sources.text: Paesani Research Group Laboratory for Theoretical and Computational Chemistry at UC San Diego We are a theoretical chemistry group working at the intersection of quantum chemistry, statistical mechanics, and computer science. We are interested in developing new methods and software to predict the behavior of complex molecular systems at different length and time scales. News © Paesani Research Group. All rights reserved. Raising the Bar for Computer Simulations Publications Highlights Download: https://github.com/paesanilab/MBX July 20, 2026 MBX v1.4 is released! February 22, 2025 Our article Constraints on the location of the liquid–liquid critical point in water is featured by Phys.org and UC San Diego Today . April 13, 2026 New MBX video tutorials are uploaded on YouTube . March 26, 2026 MBX is interfaced with the Atomic Simulation Environment . February 5, 2026 MBX becomes an official package of LAMMPS . August 19, 2026 Memory-aware SIMD-enabled permutationally invariant polynomial code-generation procedure: Acceleration of the MB-pol potential energy function as an example is published in APL Computational Physics . August 21, 2026 Microsolvation of protonated glycine: Infrared spectra from data-driven quantum many-body simulations is published in The Journal of Physical Chemistry A. August 29, 2026 Many-body interactions resolve halide distribution at the air/water interface is published in Nature Communications. July 26-31, 2026 Henry , Xuanyu , Suman , and Zitong present our research on data-driven many-body simulations of aqueous solutions at the Gordon Research Conference Water and Aqueous Solutions . April 29, 2026 Hydration free energies of alkali metal and halide ions from data-driven many-body potentialsis is published in the Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation . September 1, 2026 Henry defends his Ph.D. thesis. September 5, 2026 Elijah presents his research at the SPURS poster session. September 8, 2026 Richa defends her Ph.D. thesis.
